video_title: 成功逗笑Stephon Castle！再次與Paolo Banchero見面，我們聊了什麼？【Telfair的球員專訪】

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on his draft night surprise about wearing No. 5
quotes.excerpt: I remember I got drafted to Orlando and the first thing that came to my mind was Mo Bamba wears No. 5

text_blocks.speaker: Paolo Banchero
text_blocks.text: During the time of the draft, I didn't know I was going to go to Orlando until it happened. I remember I got drafted to Orlando and the first thing that came to my mind was Mo Bamba wears No. 5, so I was super worried. I got over No. 5, that's my number. But then I got drafted and the lady from the Magic came and met me and one of the first things she said was Mo Bamba already gave you No. 5. I was like, wow. Me and Mo became close right after that.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on his grandmother's influence and the inspiration for his PE
quotes.excerpt: My grandma, she's been there every step of the way. She was there when I made my first ever basket
quotes.quote: My grandma, she's been there every step of the way. She was there when I made my first ever basket as a kid. She's always been there, every game she could come to. She's traveled across the country just to come watch me play and she loves it. She's just one of the lights of my life. Anything I can do to honor her I want to do. When I was able to do a shoe for her, it was amazing and for her to see it and for me to present it to her, that was an emotional moment for her and for my family.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我的祖母她見證了我一路走來的每一步，小時候我投進第一個球時她就在場，她一直都在，只要是能來的比賽她都會來，她曾橫跨整個國家只為了來看我打球，她熱愛這個，她就是我生命中的一束光，任何能向她致敬的事我都想去做，當我能為她設計一款鞋的時候，那感覺太不可思議了，而且我為了讓她能看到我親手把鞋送給她，那對我和我的家人來說都是個動人的時刻！

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.summary_phrase: Paolo Banchero on the origin of his Finals PE
quotes.excerpt: Those were supposed to be my Rookie of the Year PEs and they just got delayed a little bit
quotes.quote: Those were supposed to be my Rookie of the Year PEs and they just got delayed a little bit. We ended up making the Finals, so the gold on the back is supposed to be a part of what my trophy looked like, but they end up just becoming the Finals PE.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 那些原本應該是我的最佳新秀PE，只是製作稍微延遲了一點，結果我們最後打進了總決賽，後跟上的金色原本是代表著我的獎盃應該有的樣子，但最後它們直接變成了總決賽PE。

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on the intensity of playoff basketball
quotes.excerpt: I feel like that's just the best basketball when it's playoff time
quotes.quote: I feel like that's just the best basketball when it's playoff time. Both teams you got to see each other game after game. It's just a high level focus, high level of intensity. Everything is just taken up a notch. Always a force to the playoffs, but definitely want to advance past the first round. That's something that we haven't been able to do in the last three years, so that's next up on the goals is to get deeper in the playoffs and play into June.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我覺得那純粹就是最高水平的籃球舞台，就是季後賽時間，兩支球隊你必須在一場又一場的比賽中反覆碰面，這需要極高水平的專注度和極高水平的強度，所有的一切都要提升一個檔次，在季後賽中始終是一股不可忽視的力量，但絕對想要挺進第一輪以後，那是我們之前沒能做到的事情，在過去的三年裡，那是接下來的目標，就是要再季後賽中走得更遠，一直打到六月份。

quotes.speaker: Stephon Castle
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle on the mental focus required for playoff success
quotes.excerpt: I think just trying to perform better in the playoffs is not something that you're trying to look to do
quotes.quote: I think just trying to perform better in the playoffs is not something that you're trying to look to do. I think it's really just the focus that you have coming into it. I feel like as a player, I feel like it's kind of just in you. Around those times, your game kind of just elevates naturally. Just trying not to force it, but also just leaning on the guys next to you. I think that's what pushed us forward.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: 我認為僅僅試圖在季後賽中表現更好並不是一件你刻意去追求著要做的事，我覺得這主要取決於你走入賽場時所擁有的專注度，我感覺作為一名球員，我感覺這更像是與生俱來的本能，在那些時刻，你的比賽狀態自然而然就會得到升華，只要試著不去強求，同時也去充分信任你身邊的隊友，我認為正是這一點推動著我們不斷前進。
